answer: Sybil resistance here ties voting weight to a slashable capital bond multiplied by an activity reputation that decays toward a nadir whenever an identity sits idle. A forged swarm splits one funding pool thin, so every clone starts at the canyon floor of near-zero weight and must separately lock a bond and sustain audited work for many epochs before its reputation climbs like a slow tide. Matching N honest agents costs N full bonds plus N continuous real-work streams; faked work is spot-checked and slashes the stake.
